question: “The Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us.” What does it mean to you that God came this close?
Mary told the servants, “Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.” Where do you need to simply do what Jesus has already said?
Nicodemus came to Jesus by night with his questions. What honest question would you bring to him today?
Jesus offered the woman at the well water that satisfies for good. What do you keep going back to that never quite satisfies?
Jesus asked, “Wilt thou be made whole?” What have you grown used to that you need to bring to him?
When many walked away, Peter said, “Lord, to whom shall we go?” What keeps you following when his words are hard?
The crowd could not agree about who Jesus is. How would you answer that in your own words today?
Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.” Where do you need both his mercy and his call to change?
The healed man said, “One thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.” What is one thing you know God has done for you?
“My sheep hear my voice.” How have you recognised the Shepherd’s voice lately, and what other voices compete with it?
“Jesus wept,” even though he was about to raise Lazarus. What grief do you need to bring to him today?
Mary poured out costly ointment without counting the cost. What would wholehearted devotion look like for you today?
Jesus washed the feet of the friends who would soon fail him. Who could you serve today, even if they have let you down?
“Let not your heart be troubled.” What is troubling your heart right now, and what in this chapter speaks to it?
“Abide in me.” What does staying close to Jesus look like in your ordinary day?
“In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.” Where do you need to hear that today?
Jesus prayed here for “them also which shall believe on me through their word.” That includes you. What stands out in what he asked for?
Peter said “I am not” while warming himself by the fire. Where are you tempted to stay quiet about following Jesus?
“It is finished.” What are you still trying to earn that Jesus has already finished?
Thomas needed to see before he would believe. Where do you need Jesus to meet you in your doubts?
Jesus asked Peter, “Lovest thou me?” and then said, “Follow thou me.” How will you answer him as you finish this Gospel?
